# Image

`content/image` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A responsive image with required alt text (or an explicit decorative flag), optionally linked.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Fills the column width.
- **rounded**: Rounded corners. Sets `radius: @radius.large`.
- **circle**: Circular crop, for square avatars and portraits. Use a square source image. Sets `radius: 50%`.
- **full-bleed**: No padding, for edge-to-edge images. Sets `padding: 0`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileAlignment` | one of `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right` | `"inherit"` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `width` | text | `"auto"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@theme.image.radius"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.md 0"` |
| `fluidOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileAlignment`: `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right`. Overrides text alignment below 480px (`inherit` keeps the desktop alignment). Best effort, images depend on the client.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Width honored, border radius ignored (square corners). | Fine. Images are blocked by default in some clients, so alt text matters. | Images are not recolored. Prefer solid backgrounds over transparent ones. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/image', {
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/600x400/png?text=Summer+Collection",
    "alt": "A linen shirt and canvas tote laid out on a sunlit bench",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/image",
  "data": {
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/600x400/png?text=Summer+Collection",
      "alt": "A linen shirt and canvas tote laid out on a sunlit bench",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
    }
  }
}
```
